providers.name: Samantha Myers OD, FAAO
providers.bio:
Dr. Myers is a native of Pennsylvania and completed her BS degree at the University of Pittsburgh in 2014 with a degree in Biology.

She earned her Doctor of Optometry degree from the Pennsylvania College of Optometry in 2018.

After earning her OD degree, she went on to complete her residency in Cornea and Contact Lenses at the Pennsylvania College of Optometry in 2019.

Dr Myers started her career at the Kentucky College of Optometry as an Assistant Professor from 2019-2023 where she taught clinical skills, contact lens, and ocular disease courses as well as worked with students and patients in the clinical setting.

She now specializes at 20/20 Vision Center in specialty designed Scleral Contact lens fittings, Dry Eye and Anterior Segment Disease.

Outside of the office she enjoys public speaking in her profession and has lectured at various continuing education events for optometrists across the country.

Dr Myers is a Fellow of the Americal Academy of Optometry and an active member of the Coastal District Optometric Society, the NC State Optometric Society and the Americal Optometric Association and is on the board of directors of Prevent Blindness NC; a nonprofit health agency whose mission is to prevent blindness and preserve sight through direct services and programs, education and advocacy.

Dr. Myers resides in Chocowinity, NC with her husband and daughter.

Dr. Roland E. Abundo graduated from the University of California Irvine in 1990 with a Bachelor's Degree in Biological Sciences. He attended optometry college at the Southern California College of Optometry and graduated with a Doctor of Optometry Degree in 1994. Dr. Abundo completed a residency program consisting of Hospital-Based/Geriatric/Primary Care Optometry from the Veteran's Administration Medical Center Sepulveda, California.

Dr. Abundo moved to Salt Lake City in 1995 with his wife, Catherine. Catherine Abundo is currently working as a Special Education Teacher for Jordan School district. She truly enjoys helping her students. Together, they treasure the relationships they have with family, friends and acquaintances. Dr. Abundo has 2 wonderful children now in college, Kyle and Ellie. He enjoys outdoor outings with his family such as vanlife camping, traveling, music events and vintage VW Buses.  .
 
Dr. Abundo's prides his practice on the personal relationships he has with his patients. He considers his patients as his greatest asset to his practice. Dr. Abundo designed Abundo Eye Care with his patients' complete care in mind. The practice shares a unique atmosphere of being warm and welcoming. Dr. Berger has cared for patients with keratoconus for more than 25 years and was among the first physicians in the United States to offer the original FDA-approved corneal cross-linking procedure in 2016. Continuing his commitment to innovation and patient care, he was also among the first in the country to provide the newly FDA-approved epi-on cross-linking treatment, Epioxa, beginning in April 2026.
Beyond corneal stabilization, Dr. Berger offers comprehensive visual rehabilitation through customized eyeglasses and specialty contact lenses tailored for keratoconus patients. When advanced intervention is necessary, he also provides state-of-the-art surgical options, including CAIRS and penetrating keratoplasty.

providers.name: Thomas Dohlman MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Dohlman is a board certified ophthalmologist and full-time member of the Cornea and Refractive Surgery Service at Mass Eye and Ear who specializes in the medical and surgical management of corneal and external diseases. 

Dr. Dohlman earned his Bachelor of Science degree from Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and MD from the University of Massachusetts Medical School. He then completed a Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Transplantation and Ocular Immunology at the Schepens Eye Research Institute of Mass Eye and Ear. He went on to complete his residency training in ophthalmology at New York Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical College, after which he returned to Mass Eye and Ear for further subspecialty training as an Advanced Two-Year Combined Clinical and Research Fellow in Cornea, Refractive Surgery, and External Disease.

Dr. Dohlman is a clinician scientist who cares for adult and pediatric patients with complex corneal disease and conducts basic science and clinical research in the areas of corneal immunology and inflammation, corneal fibrosis/scarring, and ocular surface disease.

Clinical Interests

Type 1 keratoprosthesis, type 2 keratoprosthesis, corneal transplantation, ocular surface reconstruction, limbal stem cell transplantation, ocular surface disease and dry eye, keratoconus, corneal opacity and scarring, and cataract surgery.

providers.name: Leyla Yavuz Saricay MD, MSc, FEBO
providers.bio:
Leyla Yavuz Saricay, MD, MSc, FEBO is an ophthalmologist specializing in adult and pediatric corneal diseases, ophthalmic genetics, and refractive surgery. She serves as an Assistant Professor of Ophthalmology at Boston University and Instructor at Harvard Medical School, with clinical appointments at Boston Medical Center and Boston Children’s Hospital.

Dr. Yavuz Saricay completed fellowships in ophthalmic genetics, pediatric ophthalmology, and cornea and refractive surgery, bringing a unique multidisciplinary expertise to her practice. Her clinical and research interests include limbal stem cell deficiency, neurotrophic keratopathy, corneal nerve regeneration, and genetic corneal disorders, with a focus on advancing diagnostics and treatments through in vivo confocal microscopy and anterior segment imaging.

She has received multiple awards, including the Traboulsi Award (ISGER), the Best Clinical Trainee Research Award in Cornea and Refractive Surgery (Harvard Ophthalmology), and the Claes H. Dohlman Research Grant. Passionate about mentorship, she actively supports medical students and trainees in research and academic development.

facilities.name: Boston Vision
facilities.tagline: Because your Best Vision Is Boston Vision!
facilities.about:
The professionals at Boston Vision have over 20 years of experience serving patients in their community through excellent and innovative eye care procedures. They are dedicated to quality care for patients as a private academic medicine practice. Each of the doctors at Boston Vision values ongoing research and education, and our team is trained on the most cutting-edge procedures available.

In addition to serving patients in our Boston office, our physicians hold affiliations with Harvard Medical School hospitals and work internationally, performing cataract surgery for patients in the United Kingdom and artificial cornea implantation in the Middle East. You can find original research from our doctors in various medical journals and textbooks as they remain at the forefront of advanced treatment options.

providers.name: James Gregoire MD, MS
providers.bio:
James Gregoire, MD, MS grew up in Lowell, Massachusetts. After attending St. John’s Prep and Boston College, he obtained his Master’s degree in Medical Sciences at Boston University School of Medicine. He then spent eight years in New Orleans where he received his medical education and completed his Ophthalmology residency training at Tulane University School of Medicine.

Dr. Gregoire joins our team after finishing a Cornea, Cataract, and Refractive fellowship with us at Boston Vision and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. In addition to refractive procedures such as LASIK, PRK, and implantable contact lenses (ICLs), he also specializes in corneal diseases such as keratoconus and corneal transplants, including ultra-thin tissue procedures. Dr. Gregoire routinely performs regular and complex cataract surgery, employing the latest technology such as femtosecond laser-assisted surgery and light-adjustable intraocular lenses to provide the most accurate surgical outcomes currently available.

Dr. Gregoire also practices routine and comprehensive ophthalmology including dry eye, pterygium surgery, diabetes, glaucoma, and laser floater removal.

Continuing his passion for residency education and teaching, Dr. Gregoire continues to give lectures in optics and refractive surgery to the Tulane residency program and has now been invited to lecture for the residency programs at Mass Eye, BU, Tufts, and UMass. Outside of Ophthalmology, he enjoys playing the piano, hiking with his Bernedoodle puppy, and debating which Mardi Gras parade is the best.

providers.name: Samir Melki MD, PHD, Founder
providers.bio:
Samir Melki MD Ph.D. is currently a charter fellow at the World College of Refractive Surgery and completed a fellowship in Cornea and Refractive Surgery at the Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary (Harvard Medical School) in 2000. Since 2015, he’s also been a part-time associate professor of Ophthalmology at Harvard Medical School.

His other teaching activities include a fellowship program at Boston Vision and a collaboration with Boston University to advise students undergoing a Master’s Degree in Health Sciences. He’s also been a tutor at Harvard Medical School since 2008.

As an ophthalmologist, he splits his time between his private practice at Boston Vision and at the Massachusetts Eye and Ear at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.

His previous education included an MD Ph.D. from Vanderbilt University and an Ophthalmology residency at Georgetown University. Dr. Melki founded Boston Vision in 2000 and has pursued an academically oriented practice since.

He is a member of a number of professional societies including The Cornea Society, American Academy of Ophthalmology, American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery, Association for Research in Vision & Ophthalmology, and the International Society of Refractive Surgery.

Dr. Melki was the Medical Director for Ophthalmology at the UK Specialist Hospitals from 2005 till 2013 where he established and managed quality controls for approximately 20,000 cataract procedures. In 2018, he was a visiting professor at Georgetown University, and in 2022, he was the Distinguished Guest Faculty at the Buffalo University Ophthalmology Department.

His academic activities have led to many accomplishments. These include the publication of many peer-reviewed articles as well as being included in several textbooks.

Dr. Melki designed several surgical instruments, was the first surgeon to implant a phakic IOL in Boston, and was the first person to implant a device during cataract surgery to wirelessly measure intraocular pressure in a patient with glaucoma. He has been key to introducing Keratoprosthesis surgery to Lebanon and South West England. Dr. Melki’s research endeavors have also included his participation in a clinical trial to measure the effect of corneal collagen crosslinking on keratoconus patients.

Dr. Melki’s hobbies include traveling, skiing, scuba diving, and biking. He enjoys photography and has published a collection of his work at www.freezingfires.com

providers.name: Jason Brenner MD

Jason Brenner has been an amazing addition to our Boston Vision team. With his educational background and experience, our patients can feel confident in the care they receive from Dr. Brenner. He started his education at Lafayette College where he obtained a Bachelor of Science in biology with a minor in medical ethics. During his time at Lafayette College, he was also a full-time collegiate athlete in rowing. After his undergrad, he attended medical school at George Washington University School of Medicine in Washington D.C. He then completed his residency training at Temple University Hospital in Philadelphia, where he was also Chief Resident. 

Dr. Brenner is a board-certified ophthalmologist, specializing in cornea, refractive, and anterior segment surgery. As a cornea specialist, he performs corneal transplants including less invasive partial-thickness procedures like DALK and ultrathin DSEK. He has also been performing corneal cross-linking for keratoconus since it was FDA approved. His primary interests include LASIK, Visian ICL surgery, cataract surgery, the use of the femtosecond laser, sutured intraocular lenses, and anterior segment reconstruction.

Dr. Brenner also practices comprehensive ophthalmology, including non-surgical glaucoma, dry eye, diabetes, and other routine ocular health conditions. 

Ever since he was Chief Resident at Temple, he has enjoyed teaching residents and fellows. He now routinely works with cornea fellows from the Boston Vision and Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary. Dr. Brenner supervises Boston University master’s students in both research and clinical activities. He is a staff surgeon at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and has an appointment in ophthalmology at Harvard Medical School as a part-time lecturer.

providers.name: Jared Jaynes
providers.bio:
Jared M. Jaynes, O.D., F.A.A.O. is an optometrist at Cavanaugh Eye Center, serving patients in Overland Park, KS. Dr. Jaynes specializes in cornea and contact lenses.

Dr. Jaynes is originally from Overland Park and received his undergraduate degree in Marketing and International Business, with a minor in Biology, from Kansas State University. Dr. Jaynes worked for a prominent healthcare corporation prior to attending optometry school.

He received his Doctor of Optometry degree, with honors, from Southern California College of Optometry. He completed his externships in ocular disease at the Los Angeles Veterans Affairs Medical Center (VAMC), Santa Fe New Mexico Indian Health Service hospital (IHS), and Lawton Oklahoma IHS.

After graduation, Dr. Jared Jaynes received his residency training in Cornea and Contact Lenses at the Southern California College of Optometry. During his residency, Dr. Jaynes focused on management of irregular corneas, anterior segment disease, ocular prosthetics, pediatric contact lenses, and specialty contact lens designs. His contact lens concentration included scleral gas permeable lenses for anterior segment pathology, such as, keratoconus, dry eye syndrome, exposure keratopathy, and post-surgical ectasias. He also received official training in additional specialty lens designs (corneal gas permeable lenses, specialty soft contact lenses, reform eyes for ocular disfigurement, and scleral shell prosthetic lenses).

Dr. Jared Jaynes has been active in continuing education lectures to optometrists in the Los Angeles and Orange County areas. His lecture topics included foundations of scleral lens fitting and complex cornea grand round cases. He has served as the National Liaison for the American Optometric Association Contact Lens and Cornea Section (AOA CLCS) and written publications for the AOA CLCS newsletter and Contact Lens Spectrum.

Dr. Jared Jaynes is a proud dad to three active sons. In his free time, he enjoys relaxing with his kids, exercising, being outdoors and has a special interest in nutrition and fitness.

providers.name: Tim Cavanaugh
providers.bio:
Timothy B. Cavanaugh, M.D., is a board-certified, fellowship-trained ophthalmologist at Cavanaugh Eye Center, serving patients in Overland Park, KS. Dr. Cavanaugh specializes in corneal procedures, LASIK, and cataract surgery.

In practice since 1991, Dr. Cavanaugh’s a noted innovator in ophthalmology. He has performed over 25,000 laser vision correction procedures for the correction of all levels of nearsightedness, farsightedness and astigmatism. He was a key study investigator who helped refractive lasers get approval in the USA and was the first surgeon in the region to use the microkeratome used in modern LASIK procedures.

Dr. Cavanaugh received both his medical degree and his ophthalmic residency training at the University of Kansas where he was Chief Resident. He completed a surgical fellowship in advanced corneal and refractive surgery at the prestigious Wilmer Institute of Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, which is consistently named the number one eye hospital and training program in the nation. In 1991, he began his professional career as an ophthalmologist at Hunkeler Eye Centers in Kansas City and remained there until establishing Cavanaugh Eye Center in 2002.

Along with serving his patients, Dr. Cavanaugh is an active teacher and lecturer at medical meetings, as well as a published author with numerous scientific articles and textbook chapters to his credit. He is also an active member of several highly regarded professional organizations.

His commitment to excellence in ophthalmology has been acknowledged by both his patients and his colleagues in the industry. In a poll of 500 area physicians, Dr. Cavanaugh was named one of the top two ophthalmologists in Kansas City. He and his wife Linda are parents to three grown boys.

facilities.name: Eye Center of Texas Bellaire Tx
facilities.tagline: Eye Center of Texas.  Your trusted partners for vision treatments since 1990
facilities.about:
Eye Center of Texas is proud to announce that Yasir Ahmed, M.D., is the first physician in Texas to offer Epioxa™ HD / Epioxa™, an FDA-approved, next-generation corneal cross-linking treatment for keratoconus. The treatment is now available at the practice’s Bellaire location, making Eye Center of Texas among the first in the United States to bring this advanced therapy to patients.

What is keratoconus?
Keratoconus is a progressive eye condition that causes the cornea to thin and bulge into a cone-like shape. This change can lead to blurred or distorted vision that worsens over time.

The condition often begins in adolescence and progresses through early adulthood. While it may not always be widely recognized, keratoconus can have a significant impact on vision and quality of life. If left untreated, some patients may eventually require a corneal transplant.

A new approach to treatment
Traditionally, keratoconus has been managed with glasses or contact lenses to improve vision. However, newer treatments like corneal cross-linking are designed to address the underlying cause of the condition by strengthening the cornea and slowing or stopping its progression.

Epioxa represents a meaningful advancement in this approach.

Unlike earlier cross-linking procedures, Epioxa uses an “epi-on” technique, which keeps the cornea’s outer layer intact during treatment. This allows for:

Improved patient comfort
Reduced disruption to the eye’s surface
Faster recovery time
A streamlined treatment experience
Why Epioxa stands out
Epioxa is the first and only FDA-approved epithelium-on, oxygen-enriched corneal cross-linking therapy for keratoconus. It is designed to deliver treatment through the cornea’s surface without removing its protective outer layer.

Clinical studies have shown that Epioxa can help stabilize the cornea and halt progression of the disease, with particularly strong results seen in younger patients.

Bringing advanced care to Texas
Dr. Ahmed, a fellowship-trained cornea specialist, has extensive experience in advanced surgical techniques and is committed to expanding access to innovative treatments. By introducing Epioxa to Texas, he continues Eye Center of Texas’ mission to provide patients with leading-edge care close to home.

Eye Center of Texas remains dedicated to offering the latest advancements in vision care and helping patients maintain long-term eye health and quality of life.

He was subsequently selected as one of only two recipients in his class to receive the Robert H. Ballard Scholarship, a four-year full-tuition scholarship to attend the University of Utah School of Medicine, where he graduated in 2015 with honors in every clinical clerkship.

Dr. Passi completed his ophthalmology residency at the renowned Duke Eye Center in Durham, North Carolina. Following residency, he pursued an anterior segment fellowship at Minnesota Eye Consultants, where he received specialized training in cornea, cataract, and refractive surgery.

providers.name: Zachary Zavodni MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Zachary J. Zavodni, the Medical Director of The Eye Institute of Utah, is a board-certified ophthalmologist that specializes in cornea, cataract, glaucoma and refractive surgery.

Dr. Zavodni grew up in Salt Lake City until he left to attend Northwestern University in Evanston, IL where he graduated summa cum laude with degrees in biochemistry and economics. He attended medical school at Duke University in Durham, NC. While there he was awarded a prestigious Research to Prevent Blindness Medical Student Fellowship to develop a novel blood assay to predict the progression of age-related macular degeneration. Dr. Zavodni completed his internship at St Joseph Mercy Hospital in Ann Arbor, MI and then returned to Duke University for his ophthalmology residency. After residency, Dr. Zavodni obtained subspecialty fellowship training in cornea, external disease, glaucoma, and refractive surgery at Minnesota Eye Consultants under the direction of Dr. Richard Lindstrom.

providers.name: Randy Carter OD, FAAO
providers.bio: Since 1986, Randy B. Carter, OD, FAAO, has been in private practice at The Eye Institute of Utah, providing comprehensive eye care to thousands of patients. In addition to providing general and diabetic eye exams, Dr. Carter has a special interest in treating glaucoma and dry eye. He holds weekly dry eye clinics utilizing revolutionary dry eye therapies including the LipiFlow Thermal Pulsation System, Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) therapy, and TearCare System to help patients address evaporative dry eye and meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD). As the former Director of The Eye Institute of Utah’s Optometric Residency and Internship programs, Dr. Carter has trained hundreds of aspiring and talented optometrists throughout the years and is considered a leader in the optometric community among his peers. He holds appointments as adjunct assistant professor of optometry at Indiana University School of Optometry and Pacific University School of Optometry.

providers.name: Stephanie Nahhas OD
providers.bio:
Dr. Stephanie Nahhas is a board-certified optometrist. She provides comprehensive eye care and fits contact lenses. Her special interests lie in custom fit contact lenses, including gas permeable and scleral lenses to treat a wide variety of corneal disease and dry eye. Originally from Chicago, IL, Dr. Nahhas completed a Bachelors of Science degree in Chemistry and English at Butler University in Indianapolis, IN. She went on to complete her Doctorate of Optometry at The Ohio State University College of Optometry.

Outside of eye care, Dr. Nahhas enjoys hiking, rock climbing, traveling, painting, and serving patients on mission trips. She has provided eye care on service trips to Jamaica and rural Tennessee and is always planning future mission trips.

providers.name: Sean Cushman OD, FAAO
providers.bio:
Dr. Sean Cushman is a board-certified optometrist with a focus on ocular disease. His special interests lie in advanced dry eye care, diabetic, and comprehensive eye care. He also provides post-operative and comprehensive eye care and is the Director of The Eye Institute of Utah’s Optometric Internship program.

Originally from San Francisco, CA, Dr. Cushman grew up in Midland, MI and completed his undergraduate education cum laude at Hope College completing a B.S. degree in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology. He then went on to complete optometry school at The Ohio State University College of Optometry. Following school, Dr. Cushman completed a one-year residency at Bascom Palmer Eye Institute in Miami, FL, the #1 ranked Eye Hospital in the nation. He was trained by some of the world’s most regarded ophthalmology specialists in the areas of advanced dry eye, corneal disease, glaucoma, retinal disease, neuro-ophthalmology, oculoplastics and emergency eye care.

facilities.about: Eyediology Vision is a premier eye care practice dedicated to providing personalized and compassionate vision care for patients of all ages. Our goal is to build lasting relationships with our patients and support their long-term eye health and wellness.

providers.name: Kriti Bhagat
providers.bio:
Dr. Kriti Bhagat is the owner and founder of Eyediology Vision. She received her Doctorate of Optometry from the Pennsylvania College of Optometry at Salus University. During her training, she received in-depth training in specialty contact lenses and the treatment and management of ocular diseases such as keratoconus, macular degeneration, and glaucoma.

After graduation, Dr. Bhagat completed a corneal disease and contact lens residency at The Eye Institute at Salus University. During her residency, she was able to gain experience in managing patients with keratoconus, corneal transplants, post-RK, cataracts, mild to severe dry eyes, and glaucoma. She is also expertly trained in fitting specialty contact lenses, with multiple certificates and extra years of training. Dr. Bhagat has a passion for fitting gas-permeable contact lenses, especially scleral contact lenses and orthokeratology lenses (used for myopia management). Being in close proximity to strong talent in arts and theater in Rhode Island, Dr. Bhagat designs and fits colored, tinted and custom contact lenses for plays and theater, including Halloween contact lenses.

Dr. Bhagat has been the recipient of many awards and accolades such as the Outstanding Professor of the Year 2017 and Clinical Excellence in the Field of Gas Permeable Contact Lens Award from the GPLI. Dr. Kriti Bhagat was recently ranked (#121) on Newsweek’s America’s Best Eye Doctor 2022 list! She is a Fellow of the American Academy of Optometry (FAAO). Dr. Bhagat is a consultant who lectures nationally and internationally to students and colleagues teaching them about new technology in specialty contact lenses, dry eye, and keratoconus. She has continued her passion for teaching by being an adjunct professor at Salus University. Dr. Bhagat is a member of the board of the Rhode Island Optometric Association and volunteers her time with many different professional organizations including the American Academy of Optometry.

One might ask what Dr. Bhagat likes to do in her spare time. She is an avid reader and a caffeine connoisseur. Taking these two activities, she started a Bookstagram account on Instagram called @Brew.Reading. This has led her to take on part-time editing projects with early-release novels, especially in the historical fiction genre. Unless you want to hear a novel, don’t ask her about her current reading list.

Dr. Bhagat currently resides in Providence, RI, and is a native of New England. She is an active member of the local community and is pleased to be able to give back.

providers.name: Joseph Martin
providers.bio: Dr. Martin was born and raised in Northeastern Ohio.  He did his undergraduate work at Hiram College in Hiram, Ohio, where he held the Paul Fall Scholarship in Chemistry.  He received his Doctor of Optometry degree from The Ohio State University College of Optometry in 1981.  He graduated seventh in his class and was inducted into Beta Sigma Kappa Honor Fraternity.  After graduation, Dr. Martin served as a clinical faculty at the Ohio State University College of Optometry, where he taught binocular vision. Dr. Martin believes that education is a life-long process and as such, returned to the University of Utah and obtained an MBA in 2000.  Dr. Martin has served as a clinical instructor at The Ohio State University and has been in practice in Utah since 1982.  He founded Eagle Eye Care, Inc in 1987.  Dr. Martin is licensed to diagnose, treat and manage ocular disease and has vast experience with managing Keratoconus and challenging contact lens patients.  Dr. Martin is a member of the Utah Optometric Association, the American Optometric Association and is a past President of the Jordan Valley Jaycees.  Dr. Martin believes that access to good, quality vision care is important for everyone, regardless of socioeconomic boundaries, and as such, works closely with various Utah Lions Clubs to provide eye care to indigent individuals.  Furthermore, he regularly volunteers his time and expertise to provide complementary eye exams for underprivileged children throughout the community.  Dr. Martin is licensed to practice optometry in Utah, California, Virginia and Ohio.  In his spare time, he enjoys golf and running around with his children.

providers.name: Nazanin Galehdari OD
providers.bio:
Dr.Galehdari  attended the University of Utah and graduated with  a Bachelor of Science degree in Biology and a minor in Chemistry in 1993.  She joined her husband at his practice, Eagle Eye Care, Inc., in 1998 after  completion of her training from the Southern California College of Optometry, in California. Then, in June 2009, Dr. Galehdari decided to venture out on her own and established EyeMax EyeCare, a state of the art medical facility, dedicated to excellence in patient care.

Dr. Galehdari has received extensive training in the diagnosis, treatment and management of ocular diseases, as well as co-management of surgical patients.   She also specializes in the evaluation and management of complex contact lens modalities.  Her past associations include the Omni Eye Specialists of Denver, Optometric Center of Los Angeles, the Salt Lake VA Hospital and Moran Eye Center at the University of Utah.  Dr. Galehdari has also served as a consultant optometrist at a number of local ophthalmological offices .

Dr. Galehdari’s  broad experience and scientific background has afforded her the opportunity to participate in FDA clinical trials with major ophthalmic pharmaceutical companies.  She is also a guest lecturer for several pharmaceutical companies, educating other eye care professionals and has also been featured several times in Review of Optometry's Women in Optometry magazine.   Furthermore, Dr. Galehdari’s strive for academic and professional excellence has awarded her numerous awards and achievements, including memberships into the Beta Sigma Kappa Optometric Honor Society and the Golden Key National Honor Society.  She is also the recipient of the Marco Achievement Award and the Kristen A. Jones Memorial Award, as well as  Leadership and Academic scholarships from the University of Utah and Westminister College of Utah.  Her commitment to community issues has resulted in nominations  as a congressional scholar representing Utah in the National Young Leaders Conference in Washington , D.C. , as well as an appointment by Senator Orrin Hatch to the United States Senate Youth Advisory Committee.

Dr. Galehdari resides in Salt Lake City, with her husband Dr. Joseph Martin and their son.

Dr. Rand takes a holistic approach in the prevention of eye disease, and is devoted to finding the vision correction option that best fits each individual lifestyle.  Dr. Rand is a contact lens specialist for hard to fit contact lenses including medical contact lenses and scleral lenses for corneal transplants and keratoconus.

Dr. Rand resides in Massachusetts with her two children and two black labs. In her leisure time she enjoys windsurfing and hiking.

Dr. Turner provides Dry Eye treatments at our Exeter office.

providers.name: Lauren Mcloughlin OD
providers.bio:
Dr. Lauren McLoughlin grew up in Brooklyn, NY and graduated from Brooklyn College in 1992 magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree. After graduating from SUNY College of Optometry in 1997, Dr. McLoughlin completed her residency in ocular disease and primary care at the VA Medical Center in Wilmington, Delaware in 1998.

Dr. McLoughlin has been with Eyesight for over 16 years and specializes not only in ocular surface wellness, but also in routine eyecare, glaucoma,  and pre/post-operative refractive surgery at our sister company, Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center.

Dr. McLoughlin received specialized training at Dry Eye University for the care and treatment of ocular surface disease and dry eye management.  She is also served as a clinical investigator for many dry eye studies and is also a subject matter expert, speaker and author for various dry eye organizations such including Johnson & Johnson, Sight Science and Dompé.  She uses only the most advanced technology and therapeutic methods available for the management of dry eyes. As opposed to traditional dry eye clinics, Dr. Mcloughlin uses a “personalized” approach to treatment. Dry eye is a complex and multifactorial condition that requires not only treating the disease, but remedying the underlying factors causing the condition.

Dr. McLoughlin provides Dry Eye treatments at our Somersworth and Portsmouth offices including Oxervate, TearCare and IPL (intense pulse laser) treatments.

Dr. McLoughlin also specializes in pre-operative and post-operative refractive care at Eyesight’s sister company, Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center.  Her refractive experience includes pre and post-operative care for LASIK, PRK, Bladefree LASIK, and EVO ICL (Implantable Collamer Lens).  Dr. McLoughlin has also practiced in a variety of optometric and ophthalmic settings and has owned two optometric practices in New Hampshire and Massachusetts.

Dr. McLoughlin lives in Durham, NH with her husband, who also owns two optometric practices in Newburport MA and Newmarket, NH.

providers.name: N. Timothy Peters MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Peters is a fellowship trained cornea specialist and one of the most experienced LASIK surgeons in New England, having performed over 35,000 LASIK procedures. Because of his broad experience, Dr. Peters has been selected to be a clinical trainer and proctor for other refractive surgeons, nationwide. Dr. Peters also specializes in premium cataract surgery and performed the first Crystalens implant and the first Symfony implant in the state of New Hampshire.

Eyesight Ophthalmic Services and Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center are the first practices in New Hampshire to offer the first and only FDA approved crosslinking treatment for progressive keratoconus.  The crosslinking system, KXL, is a medical procedure that combines the use of ultra-violet (UV) light and riboflavin (vitamin B2) eye drops.  The procedure works by creating new bonds between corneal collagen fibers which leads to the stiffening of the cornea which have been weakened by disease.

Since 2005, Dr. Peters has been a principle investigator for numerous ophthalmic and refractive clinical research trials of all phases to help assist in the research and delivery of new ocular therapies and ocular devices.

Dr. Peters was born in St. Louis, Missouri. He graduated with honors from the University of California at Davis, and graduated from Baylor College of Medicine in 1995. His extensive post-graduate training includes an internship at the University of Hawaii and residency training at the University of California at Irvine. Dr. Peters also trained at the renowned Gimbel Eye Centre in Calgary, Alberta, completing his fellowship in Refractive and Anterior Segment Surgery.

Having published multiple articles in peer-reviewed journals, Dr. Peters has also authored and/or edited multiple textbooks on LASIK and wavefront LASIK technology. In addition to providing general ophthalmic care, Dr. Peters is also the medical director and surgeon at Eyesight’s sister company Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center where he performs bladefree LASIK, PRK and the EVO ICL (implantable collamer lens). In 2011 Dr. Peters and Clear Advantage received recognition as a Specialized Astigmatism Center from Technolas Perfect Vision.

Dr. Peters continues to teach and lecture for other eye surgeons at the annual National Meetings. His hobbies include ice climbing, soccer and mountain biking.

providers.name: Jennifer Ling MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Ling is a fellowship trained specialist in Cornea and External Diseases. She specializes in cutting-edge partial-thickness (DMEK, DSAEK) and full-thickness cornea transplants (PKP) and premium cataract surgery. She also treats Fuchs dystrophy, keratoconus (including collagen cross-linking), infectious corneal ulcers, dry eye syndrome, and neurotrophic keratitis. Through Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center, Dr. Ling also performs EVO ICL (implantable collamer lenses), bladefree LASIK, and PRK.

She is proud to have helped train the next generation of ophthalmologists, and was humbled to have received the Award for Excellence in Resident Teaching at the University of Michigan, as well as the Faculty Teaching Award at the University of Iowa, for these efforts.

Prior to joining Eyesight Ophthalmic Services and Clear Advantage Vision Correction Center, Dr. Ling was a faculty member at the renowned University of Iowa, ranked #7 nationally in the field of ophthalmology. Being at a tertiary referral center allowed her to gain experience managing the most complex ocular conditions. She is proud to have helped train the next generation of ophthalmologists. She is now happy to be relocating to New England for family reasons.

In her spare time, Dr. Ling enjoys spending time with her husband and two daughters. They love to eat, hike, and go whale watching.

facilities.name: Gulfcoast Eye Center
facilities.tagline: Gulf Coast Eye Center utilizes new technology to design precise scleral lenses that correct patients with corneal irregularities such as keratoconus and corneal scarring.
facilities.about:
Today’s scleral lens care is being reshaped by sophisticated diagnostic and design technologies, including detailed eye surface profiling and wavefront-based optical analysis. Together, these tools allow for an unprecedented level of customization, enhancing both the comfort of the lens and the clarity of vision it delivers.
By leveraging precise measurements and individualized data, modern scleral lens systems are expanding what’s possible for patients who once had limited options, ultimately improving visual performance and overall quality of life.
At Gulf Coast Eye Center, we use the Eaglet Eye ESP Corneal Topographer. This device creates a highly detailed map of the cornea and sclera, measuring the shape, curvature, and elevation of both. Measurement of the sclera is vital to ensuring an optimal fit and is one of the features that sets our practice apart. This technology has greatly improved the efficiency and success of fitting these lenses.
However, clear vision isn’t just about reading letters on a chart—it’s about how comfortably and accurately you see the world in real-life conditions. By combining the Eaglet Eye ESP Corneal Topographer with the OVITZ X-Wave Aberrometer, Gulf Coast Eye Center can uncover the true source of visual disturbances and design solutions tailored to each patient’s unique eyes.
These custom lenses offer enhanced visual clarity for patients with 20/20 vision and can significantly improve quality of life for patients with poor vision when other options have been unsuccessful. For many patients, this technology has been life-changing, giving them back their independence.
However, in the long term, the best option for patients with keratoconus is to undergo a surgical procedure to halt the progression of the disease and then be fitted with scleral lenses to achieve their optimal vision correction.

Dr. Moshirfar specializes in cornea transplantation, refractive surgeries, keratoprosthesis (artificial cornea), management of difficult corneal disorders, complicated cataract extraction, keratoconus, infectious eye diseases, and other complex procedures of the cornea and anterior segment of the eye. Dr. Moshirfar has played a leading role in developing and disseminating these procedures, particularly in challenging refractive surgery techniques. providers.name: Jacob Letourneau OD
providers.bio:
Dr. Jacob W. Letourneau
Dr. Jacob W. Letourneau
​​​​​​​Dr. Letourneau is an expert in the care and management of the corneal-compromised patient. He specializes in the treatment and management of keratoconus, post-radial keratotomy and post-LASIK complications, corneal transplants, dry eye, corneal deformity, and contact lens patients who are deemed hard to fit. He received his bachelor's degree in Human Biology in 2003. After graduating from KU, Dr. Letourneau went on to study optometry at the University of Alabama-Birmingham, one of the top optometry schools in the country.

Dr. Letourneau enjoys all areas of eye health care, especially treating ocular diseases such as diabetes, dry eye/ocular surface disease, glaucoma, and macular degeneration. He has written on the importance of early detection of macular degeneration, most recently in Review of Optometric Business.

Dr. Letourneau has a special interest in fitting specialty contact lenses, especially for patients with corneal diseases such as ectasia, keratoconus, and high astigmatism. “To literally change a patient’s visual experience, after years of them struggling with their everyday vision, is one of the most rewarding moments we enjoy as physicians.” He is a member of the Scleral Lens Education Society.

He is passionate about myopia management. “With our creation of Mighty Eyes, our myopia management clinic, we are treating at the highest level, improving the quality of life and future opportunities for children with myopia.” Dr. Letourneau is a member of the American Academy of Orthokeratology and Myopia control, as well as a certified Brilliant Futures Myopia Management prescriber.

The most rewarding part of Dr. Letourneau’s profession is assisting those in need through SEE International. He travels annually with a group of eye surgeons to Milot, Haiti at Hospital Sacre’ Coeur providing medical and surgical care to thousands of patients in need.

Dr. Letourneau’s greatest accomplishment is being a husband to Karla, and a father to their 5-year-old daughter, Isla. Their family enjoys exercising, traveling, watching Isla participate in sports, always looking for new and memorable experiences. https://www.kansascontactlens.com/

providers.name: Richard Rodman MD
providers.bio:
Richard C. Rodman, M.D. is a board certified, fellowship trained corneal, cataract and refractive surgeon. A graduate of Brown University and Brown University School of Medicine, Dr. Rodman completed his residency in Ophthalmology at the W.K. Kellogg Eye Center/University of Michigan, where he was selected to serve as a Chief Resident. He then completed a fellowship in corneal and refractive surgery at the renowned Wills Eye Hospital of Philadelphia, where he gained extensive experience with corneal transplantation and Laser Vision Correction.

Dr. Rodman has been in private practice since 1997. He has performed over 2,000 Laser Vision Correction procedures and over 5,000 cataract surgeries. He is highly experienced in the use of the Intralase iFS Femtosecond laser, allowing for the bladeless creation of the LASIK flap. He also uses the Allegretto Wave Eye-Q excimer laser to perform Wavefront-Optimized LASIK and PRK procedures. Dr. Rodman was among the first surgeons in New England to offer Femtosecond Laser-Assisted cataract surgery to his patients.

Dr. Rodman maintains staff privileges at Surgisite Boston, an Ophthalmic Surgery Center in Waltham, North Shore Medical Center, Beverly Hospital (a member of Lahey Health), and the Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary. He is a member of the American Academy of Ophthalmology, the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons, the New England Ophthalmological Society, and the Massachusetts Society of Eye Physicians and Surgeons.

providers.name: Christen Kenrick OD
providers.bio:

She then completed residency training in Cornea and Contact Lenses through the New England College of Optometry. Since that time, she has held appointments at Sinai Hospital in Baltimore, Maryland and in private practice in Boston, Massachusetts.

Dr. Kenrick is a Fellow of the American Academy of Optometry, a Diplomate of the American Board of Optometry, and an Adjunct Assistant Professor of Optometry at the New England College of Optometry. She has served as an investigator in numerous research studies and is currently a member of the editorial board for the Journal of Dry Eye Disease.

Dr. Kenrick’s clinical interests include specialty contact lenses, ocular surface disease, surgical co-management, and comprehensive adult and pediatric care.

providers.name: Joel Pakett MD
providers.bio:
Pakett, M.D. attended Pennsylvania State University, where he earned a B.S. in Biology. Dr. Pakett received his degree in medicine from Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia, PA.

Dr. Pakett began his medical training with an internship at Pennsylvania Hospital, part of the University of Pennsylvania healthcare system. He then went on to complete his Ophthalmology Residency at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York, NY, where he served as Chief Resident. Dr. Pakett furthered his training by completing a Fellowship specializing in Cornea, External Disease, and Refractive Surgery at New York Eye and Ear Infirmary in New York, NY.

Dr. Pakett specializes in cataract surgery and stays up to date with emerging technologies including femtosecond laser, astigmatism correction using toric intraocular lenses, several types of multifocal intraocular lenses and Light Adjustable Lenses. Dr Pakett also specializes in refractive surgery, including PRK and LASIK Vision Correction using state-of-the-art laser technologies. He also treats dry eye syndrome, corneal ectatic conditions, such as keratoconus including corneal cross-linking, and pterygium surgery.

Dr. Pakett is Board Certified by the American Board of Ophthalmology and is a member of The American Academy of Ophthalmology, New England Ophthalmological Society and Mass Eye Physicians and Surgeons.

Dr. Pakett is conversational in Spanish.

providers.name: Rebecca McGee MD
providers.bio:
Dr. McGee graduated with honors and distinction from Cornell University, earning a degree in Nutritional Sciences. Prior to beginning her medical education, she conducted research for one year at Weill Cornell Medical College. She received her Doctor of Medicine degree from New York University School of Medicine and subsequently completed her internship at Mount Sinai West/Morningside. Dr. McGee then returned to New York University to complete her residency in ophthalmology. She pursued subspecialty training through an anterior segment fellowship at Massachusetts Eye, Harvard Ophthalmology, with a focus on cataract surgery, refractive procedures, complex anterior segment surgery, corneal disease, and glaucoma.

Dr. McGee’s clinical interests include cataract and refractive surgery. She offers advanced cataract surgical options, including femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery, astigmatism correction, and the implantation of premium intraocular lenses, such as multifocal and Light Adjustable Lenses. Her expertise also encompasses refractive procedures, including photorefractive keratectomy (PRK), laser-assisted in situ keratomileusis (LASIK), and Implantable Collamer Lens (ICL) placement. Additionally, Dr. McGee provides comprehensive management of dry eye disease and corneal ectatic disorders, such as keratoconus, utilizing treatments including corneal cross-linking and Corneal Tissue Addition Keratoplasty (CTAK). She also has experience in the surgical management of pterygium.

Dr. McGee maintains active membership in several professional organizations, including the American Academy of Ophthalmology and the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery.

Her personal interests include figure skating and spending time with her family.

Dr. Squillini is passionate about providing thorough, personalized care to patients of all ages and is especially committed to serving families in the community. providers.name: Rodney Immerman OD
providers.bio:
Dr. Immerman is a low vision consultant to 9 private practices and has practiced exclusively low vision since 1982. He routinely sees patients with diagnoses of age related macular degeneration, Stargardt’s Disease, macular holes, drug induced toxicity reactions, uveitis, giant tears, diabetic retinopathy, retinopathy of prematurity, retinitis pigmentosa and high myopia.

He has spent the last 28 years designing low vision devices for reading, distance, occupational and recreational tasks and specifically, low vision devices for computer use and refers to appropriate specialists in adaptive technologies.

He has become a certified visual acuity examiner and refractionist for six National Eye Institute funded multi-center collaborative clinical trials: Early Treatment Diabetic Retinopathy, Children’s Hospital Medical Center Diabetic Retinopathy, Branch Vein Occlusion, Central Vein Occlusion, Silicone Oil and Collaborative Ocular Melanoma Studies. Each study has specific protocol requirements.

He has assisted in the training of retina ophthalmology fellows in clinical low vision practice and theory and has lectured to in-service training groups of ophthalmic medical personal and to low vision support groups. He has been published in a national professional journal.

providers.name: Helen Moreira MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Helen Moreira, a leading LASIK and cataract surgeon at Nielsen Eye Center, is dedicated to delivering personalized eye care using cutting-edge technology. As a partner and co-owner alongside Dr. Nielsen, she brings a holistic approach to treatment, tailoring solutions to meet each patient’s unique needs. With expertise in LASIK, refractive cataract surgery, glaucoma procedures, and eyelid surgeries, Dr. Moreira has successfully performed thousands of procedures, ensuring exceptional care for every patient.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING
Dr. Moreira, a distinguished LASIK and cataract surgeon at Nielsen Eye Center, brings a wealth of expertise to her practice. Having completed her Ophthalmology residency at Brown University, she graduated from Mount Holyoke College and earned her medical degree from the University of Massachusetts Medical School. Dr. Moreira’s academic achievements include recognition in the top 10% of her class and nomination to the prestigious Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Medical Society during her time at UMass. Additionally, she received numerous accolades, including the American Women’s Association Scholar award, and demonstrated her commitment to global healthcare through grants for international medical missions in Costa Rica and India.

AWARDS & RECOGNITION
Dr. Moreira’s commitment to excellence has earned her national recognition in her field. She has been named one of the Best LASIK Surgeons in America and recognized as a Top Cataract Surgeon in America, honors that reflect her dedication to outstanding patient outcomes and surgical expertise.

AFFILIATIONS
Dr. Moreira holds a clinical instructor position in the Department of Surgery/Ophthalmology at Brown University Alpert Medical School. Additionally, she is an active member of both the American Academy of Ophthalmology and the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons.

providers.name: Nitasha Khanna MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Khanna is a board-certified, fellowship-trained LASIK, Cataract, and Cornea surgeon. As a partner at Nielsen Eye Center, she specializes in advanced dry eye and external eye disease, delivering comprehensive, patient-centered care. Having performed thousands of procedures, Dr. Khanna is dedicated to developing personalized treatment plans that align with each patient’s unique vision goals. She remains committed to incorporating the latest technology to optimize outcomes and enhance patient satisfaction.

Education & Training
Dr. Khanna graduated from the prestigious seven-year BA/MD program at Temple University and the Lewis Katz School of Medicine in Philadelphia, PA. In recognition of her outstanding academic achievement, she was inducted into the Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Medical Society, an honor reserved for top medical students.

She completed her medical internship at Pennsylvania Hospital, an affiliate of the University of Pennsylvania, before pursuing her Ophthalmology residency at Brown University. During residency, she actively participated in national and international academic conferences, contributing to research and advancements in the field. Dr. Khanna further refined her expertise through a Cornea and External Disease fellowship at the University of Maryland, where she trained under leading experts.

Affiliations
Dr. Khanna is affiliated and continues to attend conferences with prominent organizations, including the American Academy of Ophthalmology, the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons, and Women in Ophthalmology, demonstrating her commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in eye care.

providers.name: Maria Lopez MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Maria J. Lopez, a native of El Salvador, completed her medical education at the University Doctor Jose Matias Delgado, earning her Doctor of Medicine degree. Subsequently, she pursued her passion for Ophthalmology, obtaining a master’s degree in Ophthalmology from the University of San Carlos of Guatemala in Guatemala City, where she was honored as Chief Resident.

Education and Training
Upon relocating to the U.S., Dr. Lopez conducted two Postdoctoral Research Fellowships at the Schepens Eye Research Institute/Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary and Harvard Medical School.

Driven by her lifelong dream of becoming an Ophthalmologist, Dr. Lopez pursued a second Ophthalmology residency in the U.S., completing an Ophthalmology residency at BronxCare Health Systems/Mount Sinai in New York. Subsequently, Dr. Lopez completed her training with a Fellowship in Cornea, Anterior Segment, and Refractive Surgery at the New England Eye Center/Tufts Medical Center in Boston, MA.

Currently based in Boston, MA, Dr. Lopez is a Cornea and Refractive Surgeon who specializes in cornea and external disease. Her professional interests include cataract and refractive surgery, specifically LASIK and PRK. Committed to providing personalized care, she ensures her patients receive dedicated attention throughout the preoperative, surgical, and postoperative phases for optimal outcomes. Dr. Lopez is fluent in English and Spanish.

Affiliations
Dr. Lopez is currently affiliated with many prestigious organizations, including the American Academy of Ophthalmology, the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons, the American Medical Association, Massachusetts Medical Society, and the Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology.

providers.name: George Veliky
providers.bio:
After completing his residency at Omni Eye Services in ocular disease, Dr. Veliky was asked to remain on staff as a consultative optometrist and he now serves as the Center Director for Omni Eye Services in Iselin, NJ. He is committed to expanding the educational experience through his integral role as the director of the residency and internship programs at Omni Eye Services where he holds lectures and workshops for the staff. Dr. Veliky received the NJ “Young Optometrist of the Year” award by the NJSOP and serves as a lifetime member of the Volunteer Optometric Services to Humanities.

Dr. Veliky graduated with honors from Rutgers University with a Bachelor of Science degree in Biology. He is a member of Phi Beta Kappa honor society and completed the honors program with a research project on the leading causes of blindness. He further completed his optometric education at the New England College of Optometry.

Dr. Veliky has been published in The Review of Optometry and has lectured to optometric societies throughout New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

Dr. Veliky is an active member of the Clinical Care Committee, chairperson for the Industry Relations Committee and a member of the Board of Directors. He is also the CE chairperson for NJSOP’s Annual Summer CE Program.

Dr. Veliky is a member of the American Optometric Association, the New Jersey Society of Optometric Physicians and the President of the Mid-Jersey Society of Optometric Physicians. He heads the continuing education section of that same local chapter. He is also an Adjunct Professor for New England College of Optometry, Pennsylvania College of Optometry, The Ohio State University – College of Optometry, and SUNY College of Optometry.

providers.name: Melanne Rosetta
providers.bio:
Dr. Rosetta is a board-certified optometrist specializing in ocular disease. She serves as the Center Director at the Kremer Iselin location, where she co-manages refractive surgery. Dr. Rosetta is available full-time at the Omni Eye Services Iselin office, providing tertiary and medical eyecare, including same day/ emergency appointments.

Dr. Rosetta earned her Bachelor of Applied Science in Optometry from the Queensland University of Technology. She practiced as an optometrist in Australia for nine years before relocating to the United States to further her education at the New England College of Optometry. Graduating with Honors, she received the Charles Soltes Scholarship for displaying loyalty, integrity, and compassion. Completing residency at Omni Eye Services allowed her to develop specialized knowledge in ocular disease management, and she now oversees the Omni residency program, imparting expertise to the next generation of optometrists. Dr. Rosetta is certified to perform customized treatments for patients undergoing cataract surgery with the RxSight Light Adjustable Lens.

In addition to her professional achievements, Dr. Rosetta volunteers with Kremer Cares, providing eye care to disadvantaged communities overseas. She is a fellow of the American Academy of Optometry and an active member of the American Optometric Association, the New Jersey Society of Optometric Physicians, and the New York State Optometric Association. In 2024, she was honored as the New Jersey Young Optometrist of the Year.

providers.name: Michael Raizman MD
providers.bio: Dr. Raizman specializes in cataract surgery, lens implant surgery and the surgical and medical treatment of the cornea. Dr. Raizman received his medical training at Harvard Medical School and the University of Michigan. He completed two fellowships at the Massachusetts Eye & Ear Infirmary, followed by three years of research at Harvard Medical School , funded by a grant from the National Institutes of Health. Dr. Raizman served on the full-time faculty at Harvard Medical School and now is an Associate Professor of Ophthalmology at Tufts University School of Medicine. He is a Fellow of the American Academy of Ophthalmology and is board certified by the American Board of Ophthalmology. He serves as an examiner for doctors seeking certification by the American Board of Ophthalmology.  Dr. Raizman has trained over 50 doctors in the subspecialty of Cornea and External Disease. He is on the medical staff of the Massachusetts General Hospital, Massachusetts Eye and Ear, and Tufts Medical Center. Dr. Raizman has pioneered many advancements in the field of cornea. Under his leadership, Ophthalmic Consultants of Boston was a primary study site for corneal crosslinking, a breakthrough treatment that has changed the visual prognosis for patients with keratoconus. In addition, he has lead developments in laser vision correction and laser therapy of eye disorders. He has participated in dozens of clinical trials and published the results of trials, primarily in corneal surgery and ocular drug therapy. Dr. Raizman has served on multiple medical and advisory boards as well as journal editorial boards. He received a senior honor award from the American Academy of Ophthalmology in 2007 for his scientific presentations and educational activities. He has delivered over 300 invited lectures throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico, South America, Europe, and Asia and has been a visiting professor at the medical schools of Columbia University, UCLA, University of Michigan, University of Texas, Loyola, Jefferson Medical College, and others. He delivered a distinguished alumnus lecture at the University of Michigan and was the invited speaker at a reunion of his Harvard ophthalmology class. He has authored over 100 peer-reviewed medical journal articles, as well as numerous book chapters and books. Dr. Raizman was selected by his peers to be included in the latest edition of Best Doctors in America. In addition, he continually appears on the list of Castle Connolly top doctors and Boston Magazine has repeatedly recognized him as a top ophthalmologist in the city. Dr. Raizman has also been named one of US News & World Report’s ‘Top Doctors’ and is included in Who’s Who in America.  In 2023, Newsweek magazine included Dr. Raizman in its list of the top 100 ophthalmologists in the US.

providers.name: Naveen Rao MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Rao is a board-certified ophthalmologist specializing in cornea, cataract and anterior segment surgery, and is Assistant Professor of Ophthalmology at Tufts University School of Medicine.  Prior to joining OCB, Dr. Rao was a Senior Staff Ophthalmologist at Lahey Hospital & Medical Center where he was Residency Program Director of the Lahey portion of the Tufts Ophthalmology Residency Program.

Dr. Rao earned his medical degree from Baylor College of Medicine in Houston and his Bachelor of Science degree in Chemistry at Duke University. He completed his internship in Internal Medicine at Saint Vincent Hospital in Worcester, MA, his residency in Ophthalmology at Casey Eye Institute/Oregon Health & Science University, in Portland, OR, and his fellowship training in Cornea, External Disease and Anterior Segment Surgery at New England Eye Center/Tufts Medical Center and Ophthalmic Consultants of Boston.

Dr. Rao’s surgical interests include cataract surgery, advanced lens-implant fixation, and endothelial keratoplasty (including DMEK and DSAEK). He is the senior director of two popular surgical courses for advanced lens-implant fixation at the annual conferences of the American Academy of Ophthalmology and the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons.

As a researcher, Dr. Rao has authored many scientific papers and peer-reviewed medical journal articles. He has authored several book chapters on topics related to cornea and cataract surgery. He enjoys teaching and is a frequent presenter at national and international ophthalmology conferences. Dr. Rao received the Tufts ophthalmology residency program teaching award in 2018 and the American Academy of Ophthalmology Achievement Award in 2021.

Dr. Rao holds numerous leadership appointments. Among them, he serves as Medical Director of the Lions VisionGift East eye bank in Boston. He is a Cornea Committee member for the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons (ASCRS), a Cataract Committee member for the American Academy of Ophthalmology, a Board Examiner for the American Board of Ophthalmology, and an Information Technology Committee member for the New England Ophthalmological Society.

In his free time, Dr. Rao enjoys spending time with his wife and their two children. They enjoy skiing, going to the beach, and hiking with their dog. His wife, Sirisha Rao, DMD, MPH, is a dentist in Bedford, MA.

providers.name: Azin Abazari MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Abazari is a board-certified ophthalmologist specializing in cornea, cataract, and anterior segment surgery. She earned her medical degree from Tehran University of Medical Sciences and completed extensive training at top institutions including University of Rochester, University of Virginia, and Wills Eye Institute.

Dr. Abazari has over a decade of clinical and academic experience, including 11 years as a faculty member and Ophthalmology Residency Program Director at Stony Brook University. She later joined Tufts New England Eye Center, where she led the Cornea Fellowship Program and continued to focus her practice on complex corneal and cataract surgeries. In addition to patient care, Dr. Abazari is committed to advancing the field of ophthalmology through clinical research and participation in clinical trials. Her involvement in research ensures that her patients have access to the latest treatments and innovations in eye care.

Dr. Abazari is deeply committed to personalized patient care, tailoring each treatment plan to meet her patients’ individual needs. Her clinical interests include corneal and ocular surface diseases, cataract surgery (including femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery and premium intraocular lenses), corneal transplantation (penetrating keratoplasty, DSEK, DMEK), and laser vision correction.

providers.name: Daniel Hu MD
providers.bio:
Dr. Hu received his medical degree from Northwestern University Medical School in Chicago, IL, and completed his Internal Medicine training at the Medical University of South Carolina.  Dr. Hu completed his ophthalmology residency at the Storm Eye Institute as Chief Resident and went on to achieve his fellowship in Corneal and Anterior Segment conditions at Ophthalmic Consultants of Boston and Tufts-New England Eye Center.

Dr. Hu is a Board-certified ophthalmologist and a member of the American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO), Massachusetts Medical Society (MMS) and the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery (ASCRS). Dr. Hu has authored numerous research articles and presented his work nationally.

Dr. Hu specializes in the medical and surgical management of cornea and external disease. His special interests include corneal transplantation, pterygium excision, ocular surface reconstruction, cataract surgery, complex intraocular lens surgery, presbyopic lens implantation, surgical and laser correction of near and far sightedness, and astigmatism.

Dr. Hu understands that patients with corneal disorders require close monitoring and provides modern, compassionate eye care.

providers.name: Gregg Berdy MD
providers.bio:
Gregg J. Berdy , M.D., F.A.C.S. is a board-certified, fellowship-trained ophthalmologist at Ophthalmology Associates, serving patients in the St. Louis area. Dr. Berdy specializes in cornea and external disease,  and ocular allergy.

Dr. Berdy has provided ophthalmology services in St. Louis for over 30 years. Despite a busy clinical practice, Dr. Berdy has also continued to participate in clinical research protocols. He served as a principal investigator for at least fifty FDA trials, principal or co-author of twenty-five publications in ophthalmic literature, and has authored four chapters in ophthalmic textbooks.

Dr. Berdy has served both as President and a member of the Board of Directors for the Missouri Society of Eye Physicians and Surgeons. He was elected as a Fellow into the American College of Surgeons and has participated as an Associate Examiner for the American Board of Ophthalmology. Dr. Berdy has been actively involved in cornea and eye banking, serving as the Director of the St. Louis Division of the Heartland Eye Banks (Missouri Lions Eye Bank) and has been selected to the Board of Directors of the Heartland Eye Banks Review Board.

providers.name: Ranjan Malhotra MD
providers.bio:
Ranjan P. Malhotra, M.D., F.A.C.S., is a board-certified, fellowship-trained Ophthalmologist at Ophthalmology Associates, serving patients in the St. Louis area. Dr. Malhotra specializes in Cornea/External Disease and Refractive Surgery.

Upon returning to St. Louis in 2000, Dr. Malhotra joined Ophthalmology Associates in partnership with Dr. Berdy and has expanded his practice into a successful, patient-oriented setting that acquires the latest ophthalmic technologies. In addition to his primary practice, he has been involved in the education of residents at local medical schools and at the Veteran’s Administration Hospital in St. Louis.

Dr. Malhotra, along with other family members, established the Malhotra Scholarship for Academic Excellence. Dr. Malhotra and his wife were also significant contributors in establishing a permanent building for the Bal-Vihar Center for Indian Cultural Education in St. Louis.

providers.name: Robert Brusatti
providers.bio:
Robert Brusatti, O.D., is a board-certified, fellowship-trained optometrist at Ophthalmology Associates serving patients in the St. Louis area. Dr. Brusatti specializes in medical optometry and has an interest in dry eyes, glaucoma, ocular allergies, diabetes and cataract care.

Dr. Brusatti received an undergraduate degree from the University of Missouri-St. Louis where he majored in Biology and Chemistry, followed by a degree from its School of Optometry, graduating as a member of Beta Sigma Kappa, an International Optometric Honor Society. In 1995 he started working with Dr. Berdy and his staff, initially helping to build a premier FDA Clinical Studies site bringing new ocular treatments and devices for various eye conditions into Eyecare. His post-graduate journey led to a one-year accredited Fellowship in Ocular Disease. He expanded his office hours to offer patient care while still working with another ophthalmology practice and opening his own private practice. In 2014, he decided to leave the other practice and close his private practice to dedicate all of his focus at Ophthalmology Associates on Medical Optometry with special interest in dry eyes, glaucoma, macular degeneration, ocular allergies, diabetes and cataract care. He is available to see patients at all three of our office locations.

providers.name: Andrew Royer
providers.bio:
Meet Dr. Royer
Andrew Royer, O.D., is a board-certified optometrist at Ophthalmology Associates, serving patients in the greater St. Louis area. Dr. Royer specializes in multifocal contact lenses, hard to fit keratoconus and post-graft cases.

Dr. Royer is from Good Hope, IL, a small town in West Central Illinois. After graduating from Northwestern High School, he attended Cardinal Stritch University in Milwaukee and then transferred to Western Illinois University to complete his undergraduate studies. In 2005, Dr. Royer graduated with honors from Souther College of Optometry in Memphis earning his Doctor of Optometry degree. Dr. Royer joined Ophthalmology Associates in 2014 after training and practicing in a number of clinical settings including ownership of a private optometry practice. Despite a busy clinical practice, Dr. Royer is honored to have participated as a sub-clinical investigator in over 40 FDA clinical research trials testing new pharmaceutical agents and devices for the treatment of dry eye disease, allergic conjunctivitis, anterior uveitis and glaucoma.

Dr. Royer is happily married and has four children. He and his wife are involved in their community and coach youth sport teams. He enjoys golfing, hiking, hunting, and his favorite hobby is spending time with his family.

providers.name: Joseph Fife OD

Dr. Fife is founder and CEO of Paradise Canyon Eye Care​​​​​​​. Paradise Canyon Eye Care​​​​​​​ provides personalized, patient-centric eye care service to the southern Utah communities in and around St. George, Utah. Over 6,000 patients hail from 5 US states and 5 countries.

Dr. Fife received his Doctor of Optometry degree in 2001 from Southern California College of Optometry and was elected a member of Beta Sigma kappa International Optometric Honor Society for graduating with honors. While in school, Dr. Fife received the Richard Feinbloom/Peter J. Murphy Award in Low Vision in 2001 and had his senior research published in Optometry and Vision Science July 2001 edition.

In 2006, prior to establishing Paradise Canyon Eye Care​​​​​​​, Dr. Fife was awarded Nationwide Vision Laser and Eye Center’s ‘World Class Patient Service’ award. In 2015, Paradise Canyon Eye Care​​​​​​​ was named Open Care’s 2015 ‘Patient Choice Winner’ for commitment to quality patient care in the Saint George Optometry Community.

Dr. Fife was featured by Vision Source in their online magazine in August 2015 as a Trusted Colleague which is sent out to over 4,000 leading optometrists throughout the nation. Trusted colleagues are chosen based on having a high performing office exemplifying best practices serving as an inspiration to other practitioners.

In 2010, Dr. Fife received the Red Rock Rotary Rookie of the Year award and followed that up in 2012 by being awarded the Red Rock Rotary Rotarian of the Year. Dr. Fife served as Red Rock Rotary President from 2012 to 2013 and has been serving as the Red Rock Rotary Foundation President since 2016. In 2012, Dr. Fife was named to Southern Utah’s ‘Top 40 Under 40’ in St. George Magazine.

​​​​​​​Dr. Fife is an Eagle Scout, served a mission to Japan for the LDS Church and graduated from BYU. A native of Ivins, Utah, Dr. Fife returned to the St. George area with his wife and children in 2008 to establish Paradise Canyon Eye Care​​​​​​​. Dr. Fife is a Utah Optometric Association member, an American Optometric Association member and is one of only three optometrists in St. George who is board certified by the American Board of Optometry.

Both medical practices trace their business lineage to the practice of Perdue & Perdue which was founded in 1915.  Both groups evolved into multi-specialty clinics offering a complete line of eye, ear, nose and throat medical services.  For years, the physicians of these clinics have been leaders in their field.   Our commitment to treat each patient as an individual with the utmost care and concern has remained constant.

We offer a complete line of specialty services including medical and surgical eye, ear, nose and throat care, allergy testing and treatment, contact lenses, facial skin care, hearing aids and testing, laser vision correction and optical services.

providers.name: Kevin Feng
providers.bio:
Dr. Kevin J Feng graduated from the Pennsylvania College of Optometry at Salus University and then completed a Cornea and Contact Lens residency at the same institution. During his residency, he also trained under the mentorship of Dr. Clark Chang at Wills Eye Hospital. He holds fellowships in the American Academy of Optometry and the Scleral Lens Society.

Dr. Feng has garnered numerous awards, including the Award of Excellence in Contact Lens Patient Care at Salus University, the Young ODs of America Scholarship by the International Congress of Scleral Contacts, and the International Keratoconus Academy Resident Travel Fellowship.

Dr. Feng;s primary interest is vision rehabilitation for patients with irregular corneas, including those affected by keratoconus. He accomplishes this by employing specialty contact lenses such as scleral, hybrid, and rigid gas permeable corneal lenses. In addition, Dr. Feng utilizes advanced technologies to ensure the best possible visual outcomes and a comfortable fit for his patients.

Dr. Feng is also passionate about myopia control, demonstrating a profound commitment to providing children with clear vision and helping them maintain the health and integrity of their eyes throughout their lives.

Dr. Feng joined Princeton Eye Group upon completing his residency. When not practicing optometry, he enjoys playing basketball and spending time with his family and friends.

providers.name: Rebecca Geering
providers.bio:
Rebecca Geering, O.D., received her Doctor of Optometry with Highest Honors from Nova Southeastern University, where she also earned a Bachelor of Vision Science. With nearly two decades of experience in the eye care industry, she is both a board-certified optometrist and licensed optician. Her clinical training included externships at the Gainesville VA, The Villages VA, and Planet Vision Eyecare, where she earned multiple honors distinctions.

Dr. Geering has advanced expertise in dry eye, ocular disease, specialty contact lenses, and myopia management, and she holds certifications in Paragon CRT and MiSight. She is an active member of the American Optometric Association, Florida Optometric Association, and several professional honor societies. Passionate about patient care, she is dedicated to improving vision and enhancing quality of life through both medical and preventative eye care.

Outside of her practice, Dr. Geering enjoys spending time with family and friends, attending live music events and festivals, and relaxing at the beach or on a cruise.

providers.name: Kenneth Parker
providers.bio:
Kenneth Parker, O.D. received his Doctor of Optometry from the New England College of Optometry in 2020.  He earned his Bachelor of Science in Microbiology and Cell Science from the University of Florida.  He has special interests in ocular disease and binocular vision, having rotated through clinics that focused on ocular disease, traumatic brain injury, and vision therapy.

Dr. Parker was inspired to become an optometrist partially because he found ocular disease interesting and partly because he had family members who, through fear of medical visits, did not seek care for macular degeneration and cataracts.  As an optometrist, he knew he could help alleviate that fear for others.

Dr. Parker says what he likes most about being an optometrist is educating patients on why their vision is the way it is and working with them to help improve their vision to be the best it can be.  He also likes that optometry has a significant primary care focus and that retinal exams can help other medical specialists monitor a patient’s general health (e.g., diagnosing brain tumors, managing medications, and monitoring diabetes).

When he is not treating patients, Dr. Parker spends his free time hiking and enjoys baking and watching movies.

providers.name: Shruti Desai
providers.bio:
Shruti Desai, O.D. received her Doctor of Optometry from the Pennsylvania College of Optometry in 2018 and earned her Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry, with a Minor in Mathematics, from the University of Florida.  She specializes in ocular disease and specialty contact lenses.

Dr. Desai has worn glasses since she was three years old.  She recalls that her eye doctor was the only doctor she thoroughly enjoyed seeing each year, as her visits were always pleasant.  Dr. Desai has been in practice since 2018 and enjoys solving problems.  In addition to helping people see better, she also likes to help them understand how to optimize their vision and systemic well-being.

In her free time away from the office, Dr. Desai enjoys visits to museums, traveling, and exploring cities and historical places.  She also makes time for reading, watching movies/shows/theater, and rooting for the Philadelphia Eagles and the University of Florida Gators.

providers.name: Lauren Chermak

Lauren Chermak, O.D., completed her undergraduate studies at James Madison University, where she earned her Bachelor of Science in Biology. Following her education, she embarked on her journey as an optometrist in 2022.

Dr. Chermak's personal experience with nearsightedness and her consistent visits to the optometrist from a young age sparked her interest in the field of optometry. She is deeply committed to using her expertise to positively influence the lives of others and finds great fulfillment in the opportunity to make a meaningful difference as an OD.

facilities.about:
